info.name: StudyFlow V2 — Auth API
info.description:
All authentication endpoints for the StudyFlow V2 backend.

Quick start:
  1. Set the `baseUrl` collection variable (default: http://localhost:4000/api)
  2. Run "POST /auth/register" or "POST /auth/login" first — the response sets a cookie in this Postman session
  3. All subsequent requests will automatically send the httpOnly JWT cookie

The JWT lives in a `studyflow-jwt` cookie. The server sets it as httpOnly, so you can't see the raw token — but Postman stores and re-sends it on every request to the same origin.

request.description: Sign in. Sets the httpOnly JWT cookie on the response. The response body also includes the user's profile fields.
Clear the JWT cookie. The server returns 200 even if the cookie is already absent.

request.description: Request a password reset. Always returns 200 with a generic success message — does not leak whether the email exists. In dev, the reset URL is printed to the server console.
Set a new password using the token from the email. The token expires 1 hour after the forgot-password request.
Fetch the authenticated user's profile. Requires the JWT cookie (login first).
Update the authenticated user's profile. All fields are optional; only the ones you send are updated. Pass the JWT cookie (login first).

Migrate guest-mode data (stored in localStorage on the client) into the authenticated user's account. Must be called immediately after register/login while the JWT cookie is still valid. The response includes a count of inserted rows per table. Unknown columns in the payload are silently dropped.
Public health check. Returns 200 with { success: true, message: "API healthy" }.
